text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision provided it is in keeping with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting authority to enter into an encroachment agreement with the owner of 1 York Valley Crescent to maintain a 1.9 metre high wooden fence, setback 1.7 metres from the city curb and approximately 2.9 metres from the adjacent driveway; fence footings for the fence located within the right of way area at a depth of 1.22 metres; 1.9 metre high cedar hedges with a setback of 2.0 metres from the curb; 1.8 metre width stone interlocking walkway; soft landscaping fronting and flanking the property; and a sprinkler system within the boulevard area. North York Community Council: 1. Approved the request to maintain a 1.9 metre high wooden fence, 1.9 metre high hedges, soft landscaping, sprinkler system and 1.8 metre width walkway on the boulevard at 1 York Valley Crescent as generally shown in Attachment 1 to the report (February 21, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, subject to the following conditions: a. the property owner shall, at their own expense, enter into an encroachment agreement with the City of Toronto on terms and conditions satisfactory to the General Manager, Transportation Services, including the following: i. the property owner shall assume all liability and damages related to the encroachments and release and indemnify the City with respect to any claims in relation thereto; ii. the property owner must retain valid property insurance for the duration of the encroachment installation on the…
